notes: The macOS 27 SDK adds AnalyzerInputConverter, created with converter(compatibleWith:) and used with convert(_:at:), which returns [AnalyzerInput]. At a macOS 26.0 deployment target it needs #available(macOS 27.0, *); the fallback converts with AVAudioConverter to SpeechAnalyzer.bestAvailableAudioFormat(compatibleWith:).
